questions.question: How many Medical Assistance individuals were enrolled in Allegheny County in October 2022?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('pa_medical_assistance_enrollment_by_county.csv')
row = df[(df['County Name'] == 'Allegheny') & (df['Date'] == '10/2022')]
result = int(row['MA Individuals'].iloc[0])

questions.question: Between Bucks and Carbon, which county had more children enrolled in Medical Assistance in March 2025?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('pa_medical_assistance_enrollment_by_county.csv')
march_2025 = df[df['Date'] == '03/2025']
bucks = march_2025[march_2025['County Name'] == 'Bucks']['MA Children'].iloc[0]
carbon = march_2025[march_2025['County Name'] == 'Carbon']['MA Children'].iloc[0]
result = 'Bucks' if bucks > carbon else 'Carbon'
